name: PostItem
summary: A journal post in a list: category and date, a linked title and an excerpt, as a row or a glass card.

guidance.useFor: A blog's index, a "latest posts" section, related posts.
insteadUse: A piece of portfolio work: Project card
The top of the post itself: Article header
content: The excerpt says what the post is about in a sentence, not its first sentence
Write the date as people say it

rungReason: An <article> whose heading's link covers the item by a pseudo-element; <time datetime> for the date. No script.

variant.default: a row between chrome lines (no attribute)

a11y.name: Its heading; the link's name is the heading's text

focus.indicator: The item shows the outline while its link has focus

rules: The category and date come before the heading in reading order, as they look
contrast: The card: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
forcedColors: The card: Canvas with a CanvasText border; the row's chrome line: a CanvasText border
